name: Opacity-Sensitive Elliptical Bounding Box
definition: A method to compute 2D Gaussian projections as elliptical disks rather than axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs) to reduce false-positive tile intersections.
summary: This method computes non-square bounding boxes from 2D Gaussian covariance and opacity thresholds to minimize false-positive tile intersections in Gaussian Splatting rendering.
